messages:
nora_marketing: Quick sync: Seedling Snack Pack launch. Goal: single-file refapp + 8m micro-tutorial vid + 1-paragraph benchmark + 30m community AMA. Target publish Fri 10:00 PT. Need owners for repo, tutorial, bench, landing, creative.

ethan_devrel: Ill take the refapp + tutorial. Plan: tiny Q&A assistant that demonstrates embeddings + streaming tokens. Keep code to one file and <150 LOC so its forkable.

sophia_eng: Bench volunteer. Two modes: interactive (<=256 tokens) and context-heavy (>=3072). Ill measure p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec, plus cost/1k. Need ~200 prompts from Ethan.

ben_growth: Ill do landing + signup funnel. Map signups to HubSpot list "Seedling Snack - Webinar" and ensure utm_campaign=seedling_snack. CTAs: [Run Live] + [Join AMA]. Also want a short email + X thread for community channels.

alice_design: Ill make a hero GIF and 2 social cards. Will drop assets in the shared folder. Preference for a lightweight iframe demo in the hero.

ops-bot: Calendar: Fri 10:00 slot reserved. Staging preview: https://seedling-snack-preview.redwood.dev (internal).

ethan_devrel: Repo skeleton pushed: `seedling_bot.py` with README and 1-line run: `python seedling_bot.py --model open-mini`. Adding a tiny try-it curl in README: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"open-mini\",\"prompt\":\"Summarize this...\"}'`

sophia_eng: First bench draft: interactive p50=38ms p95=160ms, context p50=220ms p95=710ms. Uploaded CSV of prompts+responses. Will write 1-paragraph benchmark blurb focusing on cost tradeoffs.

ben_growth: Landing copy v1 in Figma. Wiring HubSpot webhook -> SFDC mapping. Hidden field: `source=seedling_snack_webinar`. Email draft ready for review.

alice_design: Dropped GIF + two 1200x628 cards in /shared/seedling/assets. GIF shows in-browser run + latencies overlay.

nora_marketing: Owners confirmed: repo+tuto Ethan; bench + blurb Sophia + Nora; landing+signup Ben; creative Alice. Publish Fri 10:00 PT, social blast Fri 12:00 PT. Drafts due Wed EOD.

ethan_devrel: Demo script: 5 steps + 90s live run. Will record 8m micro-tutorial Wed morning. Asking for someone to monitor GPU during the live AMA.

sophia_eng: Adding recommended runtime note for README: `batch_size=8`, `kv_cache=true`, `quant=4bit` and note about reducing batch_size on OOM.

nora_marketing: Please paste preview links and any final assets here before Thu EOD. Call out blockers now so we can reassign. :seedling:
